items.title: If FIIs return, they tend to see it first. 15 stocks from financial services ecosystem, with upside potential as low as 3% to as high as 28%

items.title: Will Sensex, Nifty continue to rally on Monday? Q1 earnings among 6 factors to drive Dalal Street this week
items.description: Sensex gained around 262 points to close at 77,764 on Friday, while Nifty 50 rose more than 95 points to end the session above 24,270 during Friday's trading session. The sharp gains added nearly Rs 44,155 crore to the total market capitalisation of all companies listed on BSE, pulling it up to Rs 480 lakh crore.

items.title: 13 penny stocks surge up to 260% in just 3 months; 2 turn multibaggers. Did you own any?
items.description: In the past three months, 13 penny stocks delivered impressive gains ranging from 40% to 260%, including two multibaggers. These outperformers were identified using specific filters: a market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, a share price under Rs 20, and a minimum trading volume of 5 lakh shares. This approach helped spotlight low-priced, actively traded micro-cap stocks exhibiting strong upward momentum.Penny stocks continue to draw interest due to their low price points and high return potential. However, they come with substantial risk, marked by low liquidity, sharp volatility, and limited transparency. For investors, success in this space requires more than luck; it demands discipline, thorough research, and a firm grip on risk management. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Own a good business: Volatility, Iran, Trump will all be taken care of. 7 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 33%
items.description: There was a time when many investors said with pride that they owned only blue chips. Today, there are probably only a few of them left. And even if you ask them what a blue chip is, their answer may be vague. That’s understandable. Because a blue chip’s definition has changed with the economy. Twenty years ago, only MNCs made the cut. Today the list looks very different. So it is worth setting the definition down again, plainly. A blue chip is a company whose management has a track record. One that sits among the top two in its industry. And one that still has a long road left to grow.

items.title: Investors looking for shelter from AI storm are turning to India
items.description: Indian equities are emerging as a stable investment choice amidst global market volatility, particularly as the AI rally cools.  While previously overlooked due to limited AI exposure, India's market is now attracting investors seeking diversification.

items.description: India's real estate market is seeing a K-shaped recovery, with major developers outperforming smaller ones. Leading companies are gaining market share due to strong finances and execution, while new project launches are consolidating among well-capitalised players.

items.title: M-cap of 6 of top-10 most valued firms surges Rs 1 lakh cr; Airtel, Bajaj Fin top winners
items.description: In the last week, Indian stock markets thrived, witnessing a remarkable Rs 1 lakh crore increase in the combined market valuation of six leading companies. The surge was largely attributed to Bharti Airtel and Bajaj Finance, which capitalized on favorable equity trends and robust domestic economic signals. Even though a few prominent firms faced valuation declines, overall market sentiment remained positive, buoyed by optimism surrounding global monetary policies.
